Help · June archive

US order cancellation

Before warehouse release

For a US order queued in the warehouse, cancellation is available before warehouse release.

Open the Orders page, select the order, and choose Cancel order.

Carrier handoff

After carrier handoff, an order cannot be canceled online. Ask support to request a shipment intercept.

An intercept is a request only. The carrier can decline it.

# US cancellation archive

## Carrier handoff
After carrier handoff, a buyer can cancel automatically for two hours. This legacy rule is retained for training.

documents.title: EU order cancellation
documents.source:
# EU order cancellation

## Carrier handoff
After carrier handoff, use the EU return portal once tracking shows delivery.

## Pickup
For a pickup order waiting at the store, cancel through the pickup receipt.

documents.title: Refund error codes
documents.source:
Refund error codes

Gateway responses

Use the complete error code from the refund receipt. A code for a captured payment differs from one for a pending payment.

CodeMeaningAction
REF-201Pending paymentWait for payment settlement.
REF-210Duplicate requestLook up the original refund receipt.
REF-305Card expiredContact billing support for a manual review.

documents.title: US return eligibility
documents.source:
# US return eligibility

## Delivery clock
Standard items can be returned within 30 calendar days of confirmed delivery. Personalized items are excluded from this window.

## Damaged items
Report a damaged item to support within 48 hours of confirmed delivery. Attach photos of the outer packaging and item.

documents.title: US return instructions
documents.source:
Create a return label in the Orders page after your return request has been approved. Print the label before drop-off.

A refund is sent to the original payment method after the warehouse verifies the return.

documents.title: Billing settlement and refunds
documents.source:
# Billing settlement and refunds

## Settled payment
Card refunds typically appear within 5 business days after the refund receipt is issued.

## Pending payment
Do not issue a refund while the payment is pending. Wait for payment settlement using the status on the original payment receipt.

documents.title: Warehouse operations notes
documents.source:
Warehouse operations notes

Delayed carrier scan

For an internal scan delay, warehouse operators should open the carrier reconciliation queue.

Intercept

Internal operators record unsuccessful intercepts with code OPS-417.

documents.title: Shipping FAQ
documents.source:
# Shipping FAQ

## Tracking updates
A shipping confirmation is sent when a label is created. Tracking may update before a carrier handoff.

## Notifications
Buyers can opt out of shipping email notifications in account settings.

documents.title: Account and workshop FAQ
documents.source:
# Account and workshop FAQ

## Receipt archive
Download your payment receipt from account settings.

## Workshops
Workshop seats cannot be refunded after the event starts. Review the workshop cancellation policy in the event receipt.
